note: Initial run used nonexistent result.wasm field and is invalid compiler evidence; this corrected run uses result.binary with identical fixture bodies.

rows.name: stores a custom prototype on an ordinary vector without an Array subclass
distinguishes an explicit null prototype from the default Array prototype
rows.source:
export function test() { const a = [1]; Object.setPrototypeOf(a, null);
     return Object.getPrototypeOf(a) === null ? 1 : -1; }

rows.name: restores Array prototype after an explicit null link
preserves a callable prototype identity
rows.source:
export function test() { const a = [1]; function p() {} Object.setPrototypeOf(a, p);
     return Object.getPrototypeOf(a) === p ? 1 : -1; }

rows.name: preserves a vector as another vector's prototype
rows.source:
export function test() { const a = [1]; const p = [7]; Object.setPrototypeOf(a, p);
     return Object.getPrototypeOf(a) === p ? 1 : -1; }

rows.name: rejects a prototype cycle and retains the original link
allows the same prototype but rejects a new one after preventExtensions
uses the custom prototype for live indexed reads with the source as receiver
